messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: 12 runtime pods restarting in us-west-2 (svc: inference-runtime). Crashloop count > 10 in 5m. Pager: marta

marta: seeing the alerts, pulling logs now. any customer reports?

dave: forwarded a support ticket from AcmeHealth — experiencing 502s since ~20:08 UTC. Could be related.

kim: grabbing kube events and pod logs. quick check: `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=runtime -o wide` shows many in CrashLoopBackOff on node gpu-05.

marta: ok can someone `kubectl logs` one of the failing pods and paste last 100 lines?

kim: pasted output:
```
*** runtime-engine v3.7.1 ***
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
  what():  invalid device memory access
bad_alloc: CUDA error 700: an illegal memory access was encountered
#0  0x7f8b2e0 in runtime::fused_attention_kernel()
#1  0x7f8b3a4 in runtime::dispatch_layer()
#2  0x7f8b3ff in main_loop()
Aborted (core dumped)
```

paul: that looks like a GPU illegal memory access during fused kernel exec. probably a kernel bug in the new quantized path from last deploy. we rolled runtime v3.7.1 at 19:58 UTC.

marta: can we confirm image tag? `kubectl describe pod` shows image `redwood/runtime:3.7.1-quant`.

dave: I'm seeing node-level dmesg entries on gpu-05: `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 79, gpu has fallen off the bus` followed by container restarts. Node flapping + GPU driver errors.

kim: trying to reproduce locally on a dev GPU but can't repro — likely a combination of model + quant kernel + specific CUDA driver.

oncall: I'm taking this pager for next 30m. Marta, handoff to me?

marta: handing off. current impact: ~15% of runtime capacity in us-west-2 degraded; high tail latencies and 502s for customers pinned to that region (AcmeHealth flagged). Mitigation attempt: rolling restart to previous stable runtime tag `3.6.8` in progress.

paul: recommend immediate rollout rollback: patch Deployment to `redwood/runtime:3.6.8` and scale up to restore capacity. also cordon node gpu-05 to stop scheduling until we confirm driver health.

oncall: running `kubectl -n prod set image deployment/runtime-deploy runtime=redwood/runtime:3.6.8` now.

oncall: also `kubectl cordon gpu-05` and `kubectl drain gpu-05 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` queued.

kim: FYI there's a handful of pods with core dumps uploaded to /var/crash on the host. I'm copying one core and the libtrt logs to a bucket for postmortem: gs://redwood-incidents/2091122334/

marta: good. also create a link to the customers impacted and raise a customer incident ticket for AcmeHealth. include fallback guidance (route to hosted replica in us-east-1).

paul: temporary traffic steering: adding a SmartRoute rule to route AcmeHealth traffic away from us-west-2 to a healthy pool in us-east-1. doing that now via Console.

oncall: rollback completed on 3 nodes; pods stabilizing. CrashLoopBackOff counts dropping from 12 -> 1 on the remaining nodes.

marta: confirm: no more OOMs? any evidence this was an OOM vs illegal mem access?

kim: logs show `invalid device memory access`/`illegal memory access` and kernel Xid 79; not classic OOM. but OOMs logged elsewhere earlier on a different node. mixed signals, but primary failure mode appears to be illegal access in fused quant kernel.

paul: action items: 1) rollback complete, 2) cordon gpu-05 for investigation, 3) collect core, libtrt logs, and driver dmesg, 4) roll forward blocked until kernel fix or revert quant fused code, 5) notification to impacted customers with ETA.

oncall: I've posted initial incident update to #status-pages and sent AcmeHealth a note: "We observed a runtime crashloop in us-west-2 caused by a kernel-level GPU fault after the 3.7.1 quant runtime deploy. We've rolled back to 3.6.8 and are restoring capacity. We'll follow up with a root-cause timeline."

marta: thanks. I'll pull together a short RCA doc and assign to eng-runtime for a full debug. Kim/Paul, please prioritize reproducer + test on same driver/kernel.

kim: started a repro job pinned to same CUDA driver (470.82) and TensorRT build; will share logs in the bucket.

paul: filing issue in runtime repo with label incident/critical + adding stack trace and core link.

oncall: handing back to marta at 20:01 UTC. I'll keep the node cordoned until further notice.

marta: ack. follow-up items: postmortem, cust comms, and a formal rollback playbook update so ops can flip back faster next time.

incident-bot: Incident severity updated to P1. Timeline pinned. Postmortem template created: https://redwood/p1-postmortem/2091122334

marta: closing thread for live mitigation — will reopen if the situation regresses. thanks all. :thumbsup:
